Production PIXEL ART for the existing Sproto fighting game. Crisp stepped pixels, dark outlines, compact limited-color shading. Not smooth vector or painterly art. Each cell contains exactly ONE complete actor facing RIGHT, consistent three-quarter side view. Preserve the reference identity, facial shape, exact eye count, colors, clothing, accessories and slender long torso. Same head, torso and limb proportions in every frame. Exactly two arms and two legs per actor, legs rooted at the LOWEST pelvis below the belly. Low hip, chambered knee and connected ankle for every kick. Never attach legs to the chest. Keep all limbs and feet wholly inside their own cell with generous empty margins; no clipping. Flat solid pure MAGENTA #ff00ff background, no grid lines, labels, shadows, trails, floating particles or weapons. Worn/held identity accessories must remain attached to body or hand. Extend cropped lower bodies conservatively using matching skin/clothing colors and simple shoes. Complete separate body drawings; no limb cutouts. Both feet need readable soles. No extra subjects.

Exactly TWO crisp WHITE almond-shaped eyes with black oval pupils, dark sharp eyelid outlines, no yellow or blue tint inside the white sclera. Pupils clearly separated from lids and visible at small game size. Large RED boxing gloves with white cuffs, entirely WHITE raised collar, black sleeveless outfit, blue low legs and red/white shoes. Preserve the existing complete-body proportions and clothing. Ranged attack is a mouth SPIT: inhale, cheeks inflate, mouth snaps forward/open and exhales, gloves stay in guard. Preserve the attached sheet's NEW clear eyes: large bright white almond sclera and clearly defined deep black oval pupils in every facing-right pose. The ranged release must be a mouth-spit with gloves guarding rather than an extended-hand cast.

Same complete body and clothing as the combat reference.

Exactly 32 separate complete drawings, regular 4-column by 8-row grid, read left-to-right/top-to-bottom. All 32 are the SAME single actor, including lying floor drawings. No opponents or partner drawn.
Row 1 INTRO: relaxed idle; determined head turn with fists rising; guarded confident stance; settle combat guard.
Row 2 SPECIAL A: low coil; shoulder windup; fully extended straight impact punch; punch retract.
Row 3 SPECIAL B: alternate shoulder strike; retract to cover; two-arm finishing palm thrust to RIGHT; recover combat guard. No floating effects.
Row 4 CAST: head leans back to inhale, gloves remain raised; cheeks visibly inflate with pursed red lips and chin slightly raised; head snaps forward, mouth opens to SPIT horizontally RIGHT, gloves remain in guard near chest; cheeks relax and mouth returns to the normal smile. Row 6 DEFEAT START: staggering upright; knees buckle; dropping toward floor with bent elbows; roll onto side with head and feet fully visible.
Row 7 DEFEAT FLOOR: entirely lying on side, head to LEFT feet to RIGHT; same lying body settles; small final shoulder drop; side-lying completely still. No kneeling or standing in any of these four.

Floor poses are lower than standing poses; never stretch them upright. All hats, heads, hands and feet remain connected and fully visible.
